title: HTTP fetching
summary: Owns validated request descriptors and bounded batch fetching for remote feed bodies.

public_contracts.name: FeedFetcherInterface::fetchMany
public_contracts.summary: Executes validated feed requests with bounded concurrency and returns results keyed by request id.

invariants.statement: Configured concurrency limits are honored when fetching batches.
Non-200 responses return status and content instead of throwing into feed orchestration.

performance_constraints: Remote fetching should keep the active response pool bounded by the configured concurrency limit.
